lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of approximately five vertical columns of high-luminance, roughly circular spots are visible posterior to the gills, organized in a grid-like periodic distribution across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of slightly elevated pixel intensity are present, intersecting with the horizontal alignment of the circular spots to form a matrix-like pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient from high-intensity highlights on the superior edge to low-intensity shadows on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple small, distinct high-luminance spots are visible on the dorsal surface and along the leading edge of the visible pectoral fin.
